WITH funding_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(p.fundflux, '__MISSING__') AS funding_source,
    COUNT(*) AS qc_count
  FROM scanqc AS q
  JOIN projects AS p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, '__MISSING__')
)
SELECT
  funding_source,
  qc_count,
  1.0 * qc_count / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
  1.0 * qc_count / AVG(qc_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average
FROM funding_counts;
